import json, subprocess, sys, time
n = 64
asns = list(range(1, n+1))
rib = []
for i in range(n):
    a = asns[i]; b = asns[(i+1) % n]; c = asns[(i+2) % n]; d = asns[(i+3) % n]
    rib.append({'path':[a,b,c,d],'count': (i % 7)+1})
order = [[min(i+1, (i % n)+1+1) , 0] for i in range(0)]
links = [(min(asns[i], asns[(i+1)%n]), max(asns[i], asns[(i+1)%n])) for i in range(n)]
order = [list(l) for l in links]
queries = []
for q in range(512):
    i = q % n
    p = [asns[(i+k) % n] for k in range(12)]
    queries.append({'id':'q%d'%q,'path':p,'threshold':[1,2]})
doc = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order,'queries':queries}
inp = json.dumps(doc).encode()
print('bytes', len(inp))
t0=time.time()
pr = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','submission/main.py'], input=inp, capture_output=True)
print('secs', round(time.time()-t0,2), pr.returncode)
out = json.loads(pr.stdout)
print('keys', list(out)[:3])
print('num links', len(out.get('links',[])))
print('sample link', out['links'][:2])
print('sample query', out['queries'][:2])
PYEOF
